tree.heading: Minimum Annual Rate of Compensation.—
tree.text: A minimum annual rate under subsection (b)(2) of this section may not be less than the annual rate required to be paid for comparable service to a pilot or copilot under subsection (b)(1) of this section.

tree.heading: Collective Bargaining.—
tree.text: This section does not prevent pilots or copilots of an air carrier from obtaining by collective bargaining higher rates of compensation or more favorable working conditions or relations.
